summary: DHT Holdings, Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 18, 2026. Shareholders representing 63.03% of outstanding shares were present. They elected Jeremy Kramer as a Class I director and ratified Ernst & Young AS as auditor for FY 2026. There are no special-situation terms: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist campaign, or strategic review. This is a routine annual meeting notification with no extraordinary corporate event. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are mentioned. Nothing to monitor for risk arbitrage.
